note: Hand-authored from the #14 grilling session, not generated by a build script -- there is nothing derived from nft50.csv here, only decisions to record. Contrast kb/fold_spec.json, which computes boundaries from the calendar.

sizing.realized_vol_estimate: std(daily log returns, trailing window) * sqrt(horizon) -- scales the daily vol estimate to the target's cumulative horizon so the ratio is dimensionless
sizing.why_no_scale_constant: raw_signal is already a predicted-return-to-vol ratio, dimensionless and self-normalizing; introducing a separate k would be a free parameter nothing has asked for (#14 round 2 Q8)

position_management.entry: only when flat, in the neutral-zone-implied direction; size fixed at entry, never resized mid-trade (#14 round 3 Q13)
position_management.same_day_reversal_note: on exit, if that origin's fresh signal is already non-neutral in the new direction, reverse into it the same session, paying both legs' cost that day; no cooldown (#14 round 3 Q12)
position_management.window_boundary: flatten at every fold/holdout boundary and reopen under the incoming model, per kb/fold_spec.md section 6 -- not re-decided here

costs.applies_to: every leg of every trade (entry, exit, same-day reversal counts as one exit leg plus one entry leg)

baseline.name: always_up_buy_and_hold
baseline.mechanics: single continuous long, full size (1.0), entered once at the start of each evaluation window (fold validation block or holdout) and held to the window's end -- not re-entered on the model's single-position cadence (#14 round 2 Q6)
baseline.cost_note: one-way entry cost only, matching costs.entry_bps -- the baseline never round-trips within a window, so it does not pay costs.exit_bps until the window-boundary flatten shared with the models

claim.why: buy-and-hold's absolute return over 2000-2026 (~30x) is not a fair test of directional skill (map decision 8, issue #14 body point 5); risk-adjusted return is (#14 round 1 Q3/Q4)

reporting.note: same 10-step scored horizon and purge-30 fold geometry as the rest of the pipeline (docs/adr/0002, #36) -- inherited, not reopened here
